Partial unit — 17 of 19 rooms. Entrance Lobby, Roof carry manual snags but have no 360° capture in this Matterport model, so there is nothing to inspect. Their 13 manual snags are listed below as not covered by the capture and are excluded from every percentage on this page; the figures cover the 328 manual snags in the 17 rooms that have been scored end to end. Parking Approach is inspected too, with no manual counterpart to score against. For those rooms the v1 page remains the only assessment.

How these numbers are measured. An independent reviewer checks every manual snag against the AI repair list, without being told which method raised what, and rules it covered, partially covered or not covered on whether a contractor working that list would fix it — not on matching wording. Snag Recall 1 asks whether the AI entries define the correct repair work, trade and location; Snag Recall 2 additionally requires one of them to describe the identical defect. Snag Yield counts one physical object as one snag on both sides, over the recommended list, with audited false positives removed. Snags no photograph can settle — a tap test, an operation check, an element out of the camera's view — are set aside as not assessable and listed, never dropped. The recommended list is what was legible enough in the photographs to act on; a sampled review found that tier substantially more likely to be worth fixing than the rest, which are kept in their own section below.
